[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Find the duplicate number** [LC 287 · Find the Duplicate Number](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-the-duplicate-number/){difficulty="Medium"}

Read the array as arrows $i \to \texttt{nums}[i]$. Every index has exactly one arrow out and no arrow enters $0$, so the walk from $0$ runs down a tail into a cycle. The vertex where the tail joins the cycle has two arrows in, so two indices store it: it is the duplicate. Two pointers (tortoise and hare) find that entrance in $O(n)$ time with two integers of memory.

[Solved in full in @sec-gr-p5-duplicate.]{.card-link}

:::
